messages:
anna: Quick copy review — empty state for Project Logs when retention is 7 days on Starter tier. Need a tone that nudges upgrade but avoids sounding punitive. Opinions by EOD?

sam: +1. Soft nudge, and spell out what happens to older logs.

leigh: Legal flagged wording in past that implied irreversible deletion. Please avoid words like 'destroyed' or 'permanently deleted'.

ben: Accessibility nit: avoid single-word CTAs. Screen readers prefer verb + object. Also check focus order on the CTA.

anna: Drafts below — keep them short.

Option 1 (straightforward):
```
Logs are only kept for 7 days on your current plan.
Upgrade to keep logs longer and access extended trace history.
[Compare plans]
```

Option 2 (less charged language):
```
Only the last 7 days of logs are available in the Console.
Choose a plan to retain logs beyond 7 days for longer trace history.
[See plan options]
```

Option 3 (action-first):
```
Need older logs?
Select a plan to increase retention and unlock historical traces.
[Change retention]
```

copybot: Suggestion: replace "Upgrade" with "Choose a plan" for neutrality. Prefer CTA labels like "Compare plans" or "See plan options" for clarity. :robot_face:

sam: I like Option 2 but swap "retain logs" -> "keep logs" for plain language. Also prefer "See plan options" as CTA.

leigh: Minor accuracy note: logs older than 7 days are not retained in the Console by default. Avoid saying "archived" unless it's literally moved somewhere. Ops team treats archive differently.

anna: Revised text based on feedback:
```
Logs older than 7 days are not kept in the Console by default.
Select a plan to keep logs past 7 days and access longer trace history for debugging.
[See plan options]
```

ben: Looks good. Accessibility check: CTA label OK. For screen readers, ensure the link text doesn't repeat surrounding sentence — put CTA in its own button slot.

sam: Also let's add a small tooltip for org admins: "Retention is configured per project and may vary by plan." Can we add that as microcopy under the line?

leigh: Good call. Also add a link from the CTA to the retention matrix in the plan comparison page so engineers can see token/retention tradeoffs.

anna: Final pass then:
```
Logs older than 7 days are not kept in the Console by default.
Select a plan to keep logs past 7 days and access longer trace history for debugging.
[See plan options]

Tooltip (admin only): Retention is configured per project and may vary by plan.
```

ben: I'll QA the live component with VoiceOver and NVDA once it's in staging. :ok_hand:

anna: Thanks all — I'll update Figma component and add to the component library. Tagging design QA for accessibility pass. Closing thread unless anyone objects.
